maria (sec-eng): Quick inventory posted — spotting audit logging gaps across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Can owners triage and add backlog tickets by EOD? High-level issues: missing standardized event schema, inconsistent user identity fields, no KMS key id in sensitive ops, and runtime sidecar ops not emitting audit events.

maria (sec-eng): Short list I found (quick organics):
- api-gateway: 2 missing events (token-exchange, route-rule-change), timestamps ok but event_type naming inconsistent.
- auth: detailed success/fail present but missing 'actor_type' and 'actor_id' in some flows (SSO vs API key).
- console: UI actions (role edits, org policy toggles) are emitted but lack resource scoping (org_id/project_id).
- billing: invoice export and plan-change events emitted to analytics but not routed to audit store.
- runtime: GC/evict ops and container-restart reasons not audited; also no correlation id for traces.

maria (sec-eng): Proposed quick triage priority: 1) auth actor fields, 2) billing -> audit-store routing, 3) runtime correlation ids, 4) API gateway naming, 5) console resource scoping.

chris (infra): I can take api-gateway. Will do a quick grep and open tickets for event names + add mapping PR. ETA tomorrow lunch. @maria any required fields we must enforce?

maria (sec-eng): thx @chris — enforce these minimal fields for any audit event: timestamp, event_type, actor_id, actor_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, outcome. Also add optional fields: kms_key_id, org_id, project_id.

kevin (runtime): I'll pickup runtime gaps. Quick note: sidecar emits to stdout; we need a sampler to route to audit-store. Question: acceptable size/throughput for audit-store?

maria (sec-eng): @kevin audit-store accepts ~600 eps burst; for runtime ops we should sample high-frequency noisy events (health-checks) and fully emit control-plane ops (restart, evict, image-change). I'll write sampling guidance.

raj (auth): On auth — yes there are two flows (oauth + api-key) where actor_id is null on failure paths. I'll instrument both flows to attach 'actor_type' (user|service) and fill actor_id when available. Will need schema bump.

olivia (product): From product side — console resource scoping is a blocker for customer audits. We need org_id on role-change events; otherwise we can't validate. Can we target a hotfix for that? :eyes:

maria (sec-eng): @olivia agree. Mark console role-change as P1 for customer-facing audits. @chris or @raj — whoever owns console infra or auth fronting — please triage.

chris (infra): I'll coord with frontend. Quick patch target in next sprint.

kevin (runtime): For correlation id — propose we use request_id if present, fallback to generated trace_id. Also adding 'initiator' field for what kicked the action (user/scale-controller).

maria (sec-eng): Sounds good. Also we need to standardize event_type values. Example recommendation: <component>.<resource>.<action> e.g., gateway.route.create, auth.token.exchange, runtime.container.restart. Keeping lowercase and dots.

maria (sec-eng): Sample schema (minimal) for audit-store ingestion — please use when creating events:
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2024-03-21T15:23:45Z",
  "event_type": "auth.token.exchange",
  "actor_type": "user",
  "actor_id": "u_12345",
  "resource_type": "token",
  "resource_id": "t_67890",
  "request_id": "req_abcde",
  "outcome": "success",
  "kms_key_id": "key_az1", 
  "org_id": "org_42"
}
```

raj (auth): ok i'll align to that schema and submit a small schema migration doc + wire-up PR for auth service.

maria (sec-eng): For billing -> audit-store routing: currently exports go to analytics kafka topic 'billing.events'. Need new connector to 'audit.events' and ensure PIIs are redacted/encrypted. Who owns billing pipeline?

olivia (product): billing infra is @andrew (not in thread) but i'll ping him in the billing channel. We need this for compliance demos.

chris (infra): I'll add a connector task and a small transform to redact cc_last4 and only include invoice_id, plan, change_who, change_when. We'll include kms_key_id for encryption metadata.

maria (sec-eng): Nice. Action items:
- chris: open tickets for api-gateway event names + console resource scoping + billing connector (three tickets).
- raj: auth schema PR + instrument failure paths (actor fields).
- kevin: runtime sidecar sampling design and correlation id patch.
- olivia: confirm customer audit requirements and surface to billing owner.
- maria: draft sampling guidance + schema enforcement checklist, will post in #eng-security handbook.

maria (sec-eng): Please add links to tickets here once created. If anyone needs help splitting tasks or pairing, ping me. :rocket:

audit-bot: New ticket created: AS-4091 (api-gateway event-name normalization) by chris.

chris (infra): AS-4091 linked. Also created AS-4092 (console role-change org_id) and AS-4093 (billing -> audit.events connector). Links: https://tracker.internal/AS-4091, https://tracker.internal/AS-4092, https://tracker.internal/AS-4093

raj (auth): Created AS-4100 auth schema bump + AS-4101 instrument failure paths. PRs incoming.

kevin (runtime): Created AS-4110 runtime audit sampling design doc. Pushing a draft to https://docs.internal/runtime/audit-sampling.md

maria (sec-eng): Great. Let's reconvene Friday 10am for status and to validate a couple of sample events via the audit-store validator. If anyone wants an earlier sync, DM me.

olivia (product): thanks all. :thumbsup:

chris (infra): FYI I'll add unit tests that validate presence of required fields at emission time. Won't break prod until we roll the connector.

maria (sec-eng): Perfect. Closing loop here — i'll add acceptance criteria to each ticket and a short QA checklist for customer-facing audit validation.

maria (sec-eng): one more: please include KMS key id when encrypting PII fields. That's part of the audit evidence for encryption-at-rest.

kevin (runtime): noted. I'll ensure sidecar includes kms_key_id meta when it uploads to audit-store.

maria (sec-eng): Thanks everyone.
